_README.what: Line ranges of Florence Nightingale's OWN text inside .txt files that also contain other people's text (flag FULL-PAGE-SCAN in _ids.txt). Line numbers are 1-based and count the 7-line '# SOURCE:' header that every file in this corpus carries, so they index the file as it sits on disk.
_README.how: Each range was located by anchoring on a heading or signature actually present in the file; the anchor text is reproduced verbatim in start_evidence / end_evidence so a human can re-check without re-running anything.
_README.caution: These ranges are the SIGNED SECTION only. Where she also contributed scattered notes to a volume (organization-of-nursing-1865), those notes fall outside the range and are not marked.

infection-jervoise-1882.note: Her 'Remarks ... on a Pamphlet entitled Infection' (dated 1867), reprinted complete at the back of Jervoise's 1882 pamphlet. Everything before the start line is Jervoise.

work-in-brighton-1878.note: Her signed Preface to the ninth edition. The 'PREFACE TO FIRST EDITION' that follows is Ellice Hopkins's, not hers.

malabari-sketch-1892.end_evidence: effectually to carry out this perhaps the
malabari-sketch-1892.note: Her signed Introduction. 'PREFACE TO THE ENGLISH EDITION' immediately after is not hers.

una-and-her-paupers-1872.note: Her signed Introduction to the American issue; longer than the London issue in memorials-agnes-jones-1871.

memorials-agnes-jones-1871.note: Her signed Introduction. Line 71 is only a contents entry ('INTRODUCTION vii'), not the Introduction itself.

organization-of-nursing-1865.note: Her signed Introduction only. She also supplied NOTES scattered through the compiler's body text, which this range does NOT cover.

workhouse-nursing-1867.note: Her letter, printed inside William Rathbone's account. Closing signature is OCR-mangled to '(Signed) FLOEENCE NIGHTINGALE.'

district-nursing-sketch-1890.note: Her signed Introduction to the 'History of Nursing in the Homes of the Poor'. End anchor is the divisional title page of Rathbone's own text.

strachey-eminent-victorians-1918.end_evidence: A.  H.  Clough.  Poems  ana  HAemoir.
strachey-eminent-victorians-1918.note: The Nightingale essay, second of four, including its own bibliography. Ends where the Dr Arnold essay begins.

royal-commission-report-1858.start_evidence: Answers  to  written  Questions  addressed  to  Miss  Nightingale  by  the  Commissioners.
royal-commission-report-1858.note: Her written evidence, printed page 361, questions 9982-10,070. She is the LAST witness in the volume; the range ends where the volume's APPENDIX begins.
